newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Airlines sign service agreement for new HK airport.
newsitem.headline: Airlines sign service agreement for new HK airport.

text.p: Four airlines, including a unit of Singapore Airlines, have signed a maintenance franchise agreement to provide services at Hong Kong's new airport, a statement from the new venture said on Friday.

Pan Asia Pacific Aviation Services Ltd (PAPAS) will provide technical and non-technical line maintenance and aircraft interior cleaning services during transit and overnight stops at the Chek Lap Kok Airport.
PAPAS is jointly owned by SIA Engineering Company, Malaysia Airlines, Garuda Indonesia and Royal Brunei Airlines.
"In addition to its airline partners, PAPAS will offer its services to other airlines operating at Chek Lap Kok," the statement said.
